text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's raining on the day of the autumn Tenno Sho. Even the clouds hang heavy with the gravity of this momentous race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios do not bow to either authority or the weather. They give an uninhibited war cry and begin the race.
